title: JFK 1961: long pause, flat pitch and a stutter
description: Three flaws at severity 9 of 10 injected into a re-voiced copy of the inaugural address. All three are found, nothing else is flagged.

title: FDR 1941: hesitations and a fading voice
description: Fillers made from FDR's own voice, an awkward pause and a fade, in a noisy 1941 recording. Five of five found.

title: JFK 1961, natural variation only
description: Tempo, word timing, pitch, loudness and timbre changed the way a different good reader would. SHRUTI should flag nothing.

title: JFK 1962 as a different voice
description: Formants and pitch moved to another speaker's range, nothing else. A speaker-agnostic system flags nothing.

title: Near the threshold: the same flaws at severity 6
description: Milder versions of the first demo. Two of three are found; the mild monotone stretch is below the detection threshold.
